title: Cozy Night Lamps
description: The coziest light sources you never knew your base was missing.
body:
**illuminate your base with these uniquely modeled lamps. Each lamp is uniquely designed and textured to more closely follow vanilla minecraft's design.**

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/APZnoklOWBs" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

![Lamps Overview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/347e7b126338ed5f95cc00944aeea9b22b82722e_0.webp)

**45 Lamps in Total!**

- 33 Wood type lamps
- 12 Metal/Obsidian type lamps
- 5 Uniquely Modeled designs and 45 textures
- 45 Crafting Recipes
- 3 Variants to each lamp

**Unique Functionality Has been added to all the lamps!**

- Lamps can rotate 360 degrees and have 16 increments they can rotate to
- Place lamp in the direction your facing
- Right-Click to turn on and off lamp
- Making a glowstone lamp will be bright, while making a redstone lamp will produce a low-light
- Shift-Right Click to rotate lamp 1 increment at a time!

  ![Example of turning](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9053ed50a6ff77f06c1fc88f7660a65ff3f3dca5_0.webp)


**RECIPES**

**Replace the torch in these recipes with either a redstone torch or glowstone to make the variants!**
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>
